In a pure sector a jump keeps the pair of occupied classes, and changing one of two two-of-three choices gives K3 square K3. This gives six nine-state components and 108 pure jump edges, so 3672 in all. Replay: python3 /workspace/reproductions/metric_review.py. The result is finite for this graph and these exact moves only.
